scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of a housing loan application I recently submitted. Can you tell me if there's any update on it?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-01860, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Okay, originated. That's good to hear! So, does that mean it's been approved? And if so, what are the interest rate and total costs associated with the loan?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been approved and originated. The interest rate for your loan is 5.869%, and the total loan costs are $17,758.29.

dialogue.user: Thanks for confirming the approval and providing those numbers. You mentioned the loan term is 360 months, correct? And just to be clear, is this a conventional loan?
dialogue.agent: Yes, the loan term is 360 months, and it is a Conventional loan.

dialogue.user: I see. One more thing, has this loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Okay, thank you for all the information.

<Satisfied> I feel that all my questions were answered clearly and promptly. I appreciate you confirming the status, interest rate, total costs, loan type, and confirming it was sold.
